evidence_class: Local isolated fixture in CI: two execution bases under pytest tmp_path, symlink, relative path and archive escape fixtures; nothing mocked except one extractor stub for the post extraction link check. Not live rollout proof.
interfaces: docker/swarm-node/layout.json, copied to /opt/swarm-node/layout.json: layout_version 1, roots home=homes, runtime=run, checkout=checkouts, worktree=worktrees, spool=spool, scratch=tmp, seed=profiles, immutable [seed]

scripts.swarm_v2.filesystem: load, parse (READERS by layout_version), mapping, allocate, contain, seed, seal, remove, extract, socket, environment, restore, FAILURES[execution_path_validation_failures]

scripts.swarm_v2.worker_home bootstrap: allocates every layout root, seeds profiles through filesystem.seed, removes a failed attempt through filesystem.remove, writes the relative layout mapping into execution.json

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards in the linked CI run
supported_versions.unsupported: any other layout_version or a missing layout file refuses and stops new launches

states.observed: Folder modes, sockets bound in each attempt, file contents and counter values inside pytest tmp_path
states.accepted: A layout document a reader in READERS parses, and a path that resolves inside its execution root
states.committed: execution.json written by worker_home bootstrap with the relative layout mapping
states.externally_verified: None; no Pod runs this layout yet

measurements.execution_path_validation_failures: Each refusal test asserts the counter rose by exactly one; success tests assert no change

rollback_rehearsal.action: An unknown layout_version or a missing layout file refuses with a message saying new launches stop; readers for earlier versions stay in READERS
rollback_rehearsal.data_safety: Restore never deletes an existing attempt; allocate keeps existing contents; a failed bootstrap removes only the attempt it created

remaining_limitations: The supervisor, health probe, image probe and worker home render still name the homes, run and tmp folders directly; a ledger follow up moves them onto the layout and filesystem.environment
Nothing calls filesystem.restore, extract or socket in a live launch yet; checkpoint restore and repository preparation packages consume them
Isolation between attempts relies on separate Pods; processes of the same uid inside one Pod are not separated by folder modes
